findings.evidence: This document's own Scope/Traceability sections list docs/modules/plans/use-cases/create-monthly-plan.md and docs/modules/plans/use-cases/delete-plan.md as in-scope use-case inputs. Those two docs each explicitly document the 401 enforcement mechanism in their Error Handling tables: create-monthly-plan.md states 'No authenticated session | 401 { "error": "Unauthorized" }' for POST /api/plans, and delete-plan.md states the same '401 { "error": "Unauthorized" }' for DELETE /api/plans/{planId}, both sourced from the respective route handlers.
findings.locationHint: - `docs/modules/persistence/overview.md` notes that `requireUserId()` only returns `null` when no session exists and does not itself enforce authentication (enforcement, e.g. a 401 response, is left to callers); this node's inputs do not include the plans/planned-items route-handler source needed to confirm exactly how that enforcement is implemented for each of the endpoints listed under Statement above.
findings.message: This Notes line claims the inputs don't confirm how 401 enforcement is implemented for the Statement's endpoints, but the document's own Scope/Traceability sections list create-monthly-plan.md and delete-plan.md as in-scope use cases, and both already document the exact 401 enforcement behavior for POST /api/plans and DELETE /api/plans/{planId}.
